composition_label: Customer insights -> Smart product search -> Guided onboarding (basic)

construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored for this isolated build

shared_schema.input: Strict object: schema_version=1, synthetic=true, fixture_label, customer{id,goal,experience,completed_steps}, feedback[{id,customer_id,text}], products[{id,name,description,tags}], query, limit.
shared_schema.output: One envelope: status=ok, schema_version=1, input (unchanged validated snapshot), insights{feedback_count,themes}, search{query_terms,theme_ids,results}, onboarding{customer_id,recommended_product_id,theme_ids,steps,next_step,status}.
shared_schema.validation: Shared validate() at each input and output boundary. Strict field sets, bounded strings/arrays, unique IDs, references, count consistency, finite positive ranked scores, top-result handoff, valid pending steps.
shared_schema.errors: CLI file, JSON and validation errors print one JSON object with status=error and exit 2; success exits 0.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated evidence-backed themes and occurrence counts provide bounded product-ranking bonuses; the input snapshot supplies catalog and query.
Validated ranked results select the recommended product; all theme IDs propagate; customer goal, experience and completed steps personalize the pending sequence.

behavior.insights: Multi-label English keyword themes, deterministic priority by negative-feedback count then frequency then ID, feedback evidence, actionable guidance, and an uncategorized fallback.
behavior.search: Casefolded Unicode tokenization, intent synonyms, conservative typo matching, query-to-goal fallback, bounded theme bonus, stable ID tie-breaking and explicit no-match handling. Themes alone recommend only when both query and goal have no searchable terms.
behavior.onboarding: Beginners receive a tutorial, missing goals get a goal step, matched products receive configuration/task/review steps, unmatched searches receive refinement guidance. Completed steps are omitted; no pending steps means complete.
behavior.synthetic_data: All provided customers, feedback and products are explicitly synthetic.

included: In-memory fixture tests and subprocess CLI tests
